title: Progressive disclosure
summary: 200 tools in eight groups. With the groups extension, the tool list starts empty and you open one group at a time. Turn it off and reconnect to get all 200.
about: 200 tools in eight groups, plus two skills.
With the groups extension declared, the tool list starts empty. The Groups tab lists the eight groups, and opening one loads its 25 tools with groups/get.
Groups nest. Open billing or users to find disputes, one child group listed under both parents.
Remove the extension under Client capabilities and reconnect to get all 200 tools in one list.
